titulo: Listen before you speak: No «is» in the present, and practice

aula.objetivo: Recognise the first 12 Cyrillic sounds, read the first words, hear the stress and say the first sentences.

sessao.titulo: No «is» in the present, and practice

blocos.ru: Это Москва. Вот метро, а там театр. Вот ресторан. Тут Анна, Макс, Вера. Антон там. Он не тут. Кто это? Это Вера. Она мама. Вот сок, вот торт, вот кекс. Это торт? Нет, это не торт, это кекс. Отлично! Спасибо, мама!
blocos.pt: This is Moscow. Here is the metro, and over there the theatre. Here is the restaurant. Here are Anna, Max and Vera. Anton is over there. He is not here. Who is this? This is Vera. She is the mother. Here the juice, here the cake, here the cupcake. Is this a cake? No, this is not a cake, it is a cupcake. Great! Thank you, mom!

perguntas.pergunta: Who is Vera? Answer in Russian, with «Она …».
Is Anton «тут» or «там»? Answer in Russian.
Is this «торт» or «кекс»? Answer in Russian.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: In English you need the verb «to be»: «this is the mother». In Russian, in the present tense, that verb does not appear. STEP 2: To point something out, use «это» (EH-tah), which means «this» or «this is». Then say just the name of the thing: «Это мама» (EH-tah MAH-mah), literally «this mom». STEP 3: With «он» (ohn) and «она» (ah-NAH) it is the same: «Он Антон» (ohn ahn-TOHN), «Она мама» (ah-NAH MAH-mah). There is no word between the subject and the rest. STEP 4: To negate, put «не» (nyeh) before the word: «Это не торт» (EH-tah nyeh tort), this is not a cake. The word «нет» is kept for the short answer: «Нет». STEP 5: To ask a question, keep the same sentence and raise your voice on the word you are asking about: «Это торт?». The word order does not change. STEP 6: There is a word «есть» (yest), which the dictionary translates as «to be». In everyday speech it does not go in these sentences. Do not say «Это есть мама».
blocos.comparacao: in English «She is the mother» has four words, and «is» is required. In Russian «Она мама» is enough, two words. The verb «to be» in the present simply does not exist.

erros.motivo: In the present tense «есть» is not used in place of «is». The sentence has only «Это» and the name.
Inside a sentence, the negation is «не» and it comes before the word. «нет» is the «no» of the short answer.

itens.explicacao: In the present tense Russian does not use «is». «Это мама» already means «this is the mother».

itens.gabarito: none: the verb is left out
itens.explicacao: Russian has no «to be» in the present tense. The sentence is just «she mother», and that is enough.

itens.enunciado: «Она» means:
itens.explicacao: «Она» is «she». «Он» is «he» and «мама» is «mom». Listen to the difference: ah-NAH and ohn.

itens.enunciado: How do you say «This is not a cake»?
itens.explicacao: The negation «не» comes right before the negated word. «нет» is only for the short answer.

itens.enunciado: Это не торт, это ___.
itens.explicacao: The sentence contrasts two things: it is not a cake, it is a cupcake. «как» is «how» and «тут» is «here».

itens.enunciado: — Кто это? — ___ Вера.
itens.explicacao: To introduce someone, you say «Это» and the name. «Как» is «how» and «Нет» is «no».

itens.enunciado: Listen, repeat aloud and then show the answer.
itens.explicacao: Vera, how are you?

itens.enunciado: Вот метро, а ___ театр. (lá)
itens.explicacao: The meaning is «over there», far from the speaker: «там». «тут» is «here».

itens.enunciado: Антон ___, а Анна там. (here)
itens.explicacao: Here is «тут», over there is «там». The sentence contrasts the two places.

itens.enunciado: Put in order: «She is the mother.»
itens.explicacao: No «is»: the subject «Она» comes first, then «мама».

itens.enunciado: Put in order: «This is not a cake.»
itens.explicacao: «не» comes immediately before the negated word: «Это не торт».

itens.enunciado: Listen, repeat aloud and then show the answer.
itens.explicacao: And this one, who is she?

itens.enunciado: Put in order: «There is the theatre.»
itens.explicacao: «Там» (over there) opens the sentence and then comes the thing. There is no verb «to be».

itens.enunciado: Write in Russian: «This is Anna. She is the mother.»
Write in Russian, in Cyrillic, two sentences with «Это» about things you learned today.
Read aloud and write in English: «Кто там? Там Вера, она сестра.»
itens.respostaEsperada: Who is over there? Vera is over there, she is the sister.

blocos.enunciado: Record yourself for 30 seconds: point to four things or photos around you and say «Это …» for each one, using «сок, торт, кекс, мама, сестра». Then say «Это не торт, это кекс.» and finish with «Спасибо!».
blocos.exemplo: Кто это? Это мама. Она мама. Спасибо!
